doc: A typed data table — the reference consumer of the shared tutuca:component/tables vocabulary.

components.name: Table
components.doc: Tabular data as typed columns: a sortable, paged table you hand a set of columns and their values.

messageDocs.name: sortBy
messageDocs.doc: Sort by a column; clicking the sorted one reverses it.

messageDocs.name: nextPage
messageDocs.doc: Show the next page of rows.

messageDocs.name: prevPage
messageDocs.doc: Show the previous page of rows.

messageDocs.name: load
messageDocs.doc: Replace the data with a new table.

messageDocs.name: clear
messageDocs.doc: Drop every row, keeping the columns.

fields.name: data
fields.doc: The table to show: one entry per column, each with a stable id, a label, a type (i32, f64, str or bool) and its values in row order. Every column must have the same number of values; use null for a missing one.

fields.name: pageSize
fields.doc: How many rows to show at once.

inits.name: cities
inits.doc: Four cities across all four column types, one population missing, paged three at a time.
